_about: The core idea of a root (Korijeni / Roots, docs/ROOTS-PLAN.md): one line, bs + en, in our own words, grounded in ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī's Mufradāt entry for the root and verified against the OpenITI text (0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, read locally, never shipped or quoted). A root whose entry gives no base sense we can vouch for has no line. Validated on load (fil.roots.model.parse_core_ideas).

core.bs: Govor iskazan riječima – a u prenesenom smislu i ono što se misli ili vjeruje.
core.en: Speech put into words — and, by extension, what one holds in mind or believes.

قول.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry قول: first sense is uttered speech; further senses include what is in the mind before uttering and belief/doctrine.

core.bs: Biti ili bivati: upućuje na ono što je bilo, često na trajno svojstvo; može značiti i ‚dogodilo se‘.
core.en: Being or having been: it points to what was, often to a lasting trait; it can also mean ‘came about’.

كون.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry كان: kāna expresses past time, with a described trait signalling it is inseparable; one reading glosses it as ‚happened, occurred‘.

core.bs: Odgajanje i razvijanje nečega korak po korak do potpunosti; otuda Gospodar – bez dodatka samo za Allaha.
core.en: Nurturing a thing stage by stage to completion; hence Lord — said absolutely only of Allah.

ربب.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry رب: al-rabb in origin is tarbiya, raising a thing state by state to completion; unqualified rabb is said only of God.

core.bs: Smirenost duše i nestanak straha; otuda povjerenje, emanet i vjerovanje.
core.en: Inner calm and the removal of fear; from it come trust, what is entrusted, and faith.

أمن.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry أمن: the root sense (asl) is tranquillity of the soul and removal of fear; amāna (trust) and īmān (faith) are treated under it.

core.bs: Spoznaja stvari onakve kakva uistinu jest – znati šta je, ili ispravno suditi šta joj pripada.
core.en: Grasping a thing as it truly is — knowing what it is, or rightly judging what holds true of it.

علم.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry علم: ʿilm is perceiving a thing in its reality, of two kinds: perceiving its essence, and judging something present or absent in it.

core.bs: Stajanje: uspravno tijelom, staranje o nečemu ili ustajanje s odlukom da se djeluje; i ono na čemu nešto stoji.
core.en: Standing: upright in body, standing by something to keep it, or rising resolved to act; also what a thing stands on.

قوم.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry قوم: qiyām is of three kinds (bodily standing, maintaining/guarding a thing, resolve), and qiyām/qawām names what a thing stands firm by.

core.bs: Jasan znak vezan za nešto skriveno, pa ko spozna znak spozna i drugo; i ajet Kur'ana, te upitno ‚koji?‘.
core.en: A clear sign bound to something hidden, so grasping one reveals the other; also a verse of the Quran, and ‘which?’.

أيي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry أي: āya is the manifest sign inseparable from something not manifest; also each Qur'anic unit; ayy asks after one of a kind.

core.bs: Dolazak s lakoćom – lično, ili naredbom i odredbom; u obliku آتى donošenje, davanje.
core.en: Coming with ease — in person, or by command and decree; in the form آتى, bringing or giving.

أتي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry أتى: ityān is coming with ease, said of coming in person and by command/arrangement; ātā (giving) is discussed in the same entry.

core.bs: Prekrivanje nečega – nezahvalnost skriva blagodat; najteži oblik je poricanje Allahove jednoće, šerijata ili poslanstva.
core.en: Covering something over — ingratitude hides a favour; its gravest form is denying Allah's oneness, law or prophethood.

كفر.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry كفر: kufr linguistically is covering a thing; ingratitude covers a favour; the greatest kufr is denying oneness, sharia or prophethood.

core.bs: Prostor između dvije stvari; otuda razdvajanje i postajanje jasnim – skriveno se odvoji i pokaže.
core.en: The space between two things; hence separating, and becoming clear — what was hidden stands apart and shows.

بين.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry بين: bayn denotes the gap between two things; bāna means to separate and for what was hidden to appear (bayyina = clear evidence).

core.bs: Stvar: neki je određuju kao sve što se može znati i o čemu se može govoriti; drugi je vežu za htijenje (شاء).
core.en: A thing: some define it as whatever can be known and spoken of; others tie it to willing (شاء).

شيأ.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry شيء: shayʾ is what can be known and reported, originally the verbal noun of shāʾa; God's will entails the thing's existence (mā shāʾa Allāh kān). Reworded on review: the definitions are given as the views of others (qīla, ʿinda baʿḍihim), as the entry gives them.

core.bs: Odašiljanje laganim hodom; otuda blagost, i poslanik – onaj koji je poslan noseći poruku.
core.en: Being sent off at an easy pace; hence gentleness, and a messenger — one sent bearing a message.

رسل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry رسل: the root sense (asl) is setting off unhurriedly; from it both gentleness (ʿalā rislik) and rasūl, the one sent / bearer of the message.

core.bs: Dan: od izlaska do zalaska sunca – a i bilo koji period vremena.
core.en: Day: from sunrise to sunset — and any span of time at all.

يوم.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry يوم: yawm is the time from sunrise to sunset, and is also used for any period of time.

core.bs: Zemlja, tijelo nasuprot nebu; i najniži dio bilo čega.
core.en: Earth, the body set against the sky; also the lowest part of anything.

أرض.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry أرض: arḍ is the body facing the sky, and expresses the lower part of a thing as samāʾ expresses its top.

core.bs: Najviši dio bilo čega; otuda nebo – i kiša, koja s njega dolazi.
core.en: The highest part of anything; hence the sky — and rain, which comes from it.

سمو.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry سما: samāʾ of anything is its top; the sky opposite the earth, and rain called samāʾ because it comes from it.

core.bs: Slatka, pitka voda; i عذاب: žestoka bol ili kazna (kako su povezani, sporno je).
core.en: Sweet, fresh water; and عذاب: severe pain or punishment (how the two connect is disputed).

عذب.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry عذب: entry opens with sweet cool water, defines ʿadhāb as severe infliction of pain, and says its origin is disputed.

core.bs: Namjerno djelovanje živog bića – uže od pukog činjenja; kaže se i za dobra i za loša djela.
core.en: Deliberate action by a living being — narrower than mere doing; used of good and evil deeds alike.

عمل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry عمل: ʿamal is every act done with intent by a living being, more specific than fiʿl, used for righteous and evil deeds.

core.bs: Najopćiji glagol činjenja: početi, stvoriti, napraviti od nečega, preobratiti u nešto ili proglasiti.
core.en: The most general verb of doing: to begin, to bring about, to make from, to turn into, or to deem.

جعل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry جعل: jaʿala is the most general verb of action, more general than faʿala and ṣanaʿa, with five uses listed.

core.bs: Materica, a otuda i rodbinska veza; milost je nježnost koja vodi dobročinstvu – od Allaha čisto dobročinstvo i blagodat.
core.en: The womb, and kinship from it; mercy is tenderness moving to kindness — from Allah, pure kindness and grace.

رحم.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry رحم: raḥim is the womb, borrowed for kinship; raḥma is tenderness entailing kindness, and of God denotes kindness alone without tenderness.

core.bs: Ljudski rod nasuprot džinima; i bliskost, suprotno otuđenju – osjećati se prisno s nekim.
core.en: Humankind as opposed to jinn; and familiarity, the opposite of shying away — being at ease with someone.

أنس.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry إنس: al-ins is the opposite of jinn, and uns the opposite of nufūr (shying away); insān linked to mutual familiarity.

core.bs: Opažanje – okom, maštom, razmišljanjem ili razumom; otuda i mišljenje koje čovjek zauzme o nečemu.
core.en: Perceiving – with the eyes, the imagination, reflection or the intellect; hence also an opinion one comes to hold.

رأي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry رأى: ru'ya is defined as perceiving the seen, in four kinds (sense, imagination, reflection, intellect), and ra'y as a belief held on preponderant supposition.

core.bs: Spajanje dijelova – najprije kože šivenjem, zatim slova pisanjem; u prenesenom smislu utvrditi, odrediti ili propisati.
core.en: Joining pieces together – first leather by stitching, then letters in writing; by extension, fixing, decreeing or prescribing.

كتب.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry كتب: the base is joining leather to leather by sewing, then joining letters in script, and kitāba is used for establishing, decreeing, obligating and prescribing.

core.bs: Upućivanje blagim i obzirnim pokazivanjem puta; od istog korijena je i poklon.
core.en: Guiding by gently and kindly showing the way; the same root also gives the word for a gift.

هدي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry هدى: hidāya is defined as guidance given with gentleness, and hadiyya (gift) is derived from it.

core.bs: Stavljanje stvari mimo njenog mjesta, prelaženje granice istine; od istog korijena je i tama, odsustvo svjetla.
core.en: Putting a thing where it does not belong, overstepping what is right; the same root gives darkness, the absence of light.

ظلم.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry ظلم: ẓulm is placing a thing other than in its proper place and overstepping the right, and ẓulma is the absence of light.

core.bs: Duša, odnosno sopstvo i bit nečega; od istog korijena je i dah koji ulazi u tijelo i izlazi iz njega.
core.en: The soul – the self, the very essence of a being; the same root gives breath, the air drawn in and out of the body.

نفس.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry نفس: nafs is glossed as the spirit and as a being's self/essence, and nafas as the air entering and leaving the body.

core.bs: Biti ispred – po mjestu, vremenu, rangu ili redoslijedu, suprotno od poslije; i okretanje prema nečemu i primanje toga.
core.en: Being before – in place, time, rank or order, the opposite of after; also turning toward something and accepting it.

قبل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry قبل: qabl denotes precedence (place, time, rank, ordered sequence) opposed to baʿd; iqbāl is facing toward, and qabūl is accepting (excuse, repentance, deeds).

core.bs: Spuštanje s visine; i odsjedanje na nekom mjestu, a od Allaha spuštanje objave, blagodati ili kazne.
core.en: Descending from a height; also halting somewhere to stay, and, from Allah, sending down revelation, blessings or punishment.

نزل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry نزل: nuzūl is originally descent from a height, also alighting at a place, and Allah's inzāl of His favours, punishments and the Book.

core.bs: Držanje znanja prisutnim u svijesti – sjećanje srcem ili spominjanje jezikom.
core.en: Keeping knowledge present in mind – remembering in the heart or mentioning with the tongue.

ذكر.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry ذكر: dhikr is a faculty of retaining knowledge viewed as making it present, and the presence of a thing in the heart or speech, hence dhikr of heart and of tongue.

core.bs: Tačno podudaranje – ono što odgovara stvarnosti, ili biva onako, onda i onoliko koliko treba; otuda istina.
core.en: Exact correspondence – what matches how a thing really is, or happens as, when and as much as it should; hence truth.

حقق.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry حق: the asl of ḥaqq is correspondence and agreement, applied to belief matching its object and to acts and words occurring as, as much as and when they must.

core.bs: Govoriti ono što se ne slaže sa stvarnošću ili s vlastitim uvjerenjem; a u pojačanom obliku proglasiti nekoga lašcem.
core.en: Saying what does not match the facts or one's own belief; in the intensive form, branding someone a liar.

كذب.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entries كذب and صدق: truth and lying belong originally to statements, truth being agreement of speech with conviction and the thing reported; takdhīb is ascribing lying to someone, in the Qur'an to the truthful.

core.bs: Dolazak koji se ostvari – ljudi, stvari ili pojmova, lično ili naredbom; s prijedlogom bi- znači donijeti nešto.
core.en: Coming that actually arrives – of people, things or ideas, in person or by command; with ‘bi-’ it means to bring.

جيأ.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry جاء: majīʾ is like ityān but broader and said with regard to actual arrival, of entities and meanings, by itself or by command; jāʾa bi- means to bring/produce.

core.bs: Iskazivanje poniznosti; ibadet je njen najviši stepen i pripada samo Allahu, Onome Čija je dobrota najveća.
core.en: Showing humble submission; worship is its utmost degree, owed only to Allah, the One whose bounty is greatest.

عبد.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry عبد: ʿubūdiyya is showing humility and ʿibāda its utmost degree, deserved only by the One of utmost bounty, Allah.

core.bs: Prisvajanje i dobijanje nečega – uzimanjem rukom ili silom, kao kad kazna zahvati neki narod.
core.en: Getting hold of something and securing it – by taking it in hand, or by force, as when punishment seizes a people.

أخذ.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry أخذ: akhdh is acquiring and obtaining a thing, sometimes by taking hold and sometimes by overpowering, as with sleep, fever or punishment.

core.bs: Ispravno odmjeravanje; otuda stvaranje bez uzora – što pripada samo Allahu – ili tvorenje jedne stvari od druge.
core.en: Measuring out rightly; hence bringing into being without a model – which belongs to Allah alone – or making one thing from another.

خلق.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry خلق: the asl of khalq is right measuring (taqdīr), used for originating without precedent, which is Allah's alone, and for producing a thing from another.

core.bs: Čuvanje nečega od onoga što mu šteti; takvaluk je stavljanje sebe pod zaštitu od onoga čega se čovjek boji.
core.en: Shielding something from what harms it; taqwa is placing oneself under such protection from what one fears.

وقي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry وقى: wiqāya is protecting a thing from what harms it, and taqwā is putting oneself in protection from what is feared.

core.bs: Ono što dolazi poslije – posljednje naspram prvog, odgađanje naspram prednošenja; otuda i Ahiret, drugi život.
core.en: What comes after – the last as against the first, delaying as against putting forward; hence the Hereafter, the second life.

أخر.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry آخر: ākhir is set against awwal, al-dār al-ākhira denotes the second existence, and taʾkhīr is the opposite of taqdīm.

core.bs: Stvar ili posao, svako djelo i riječ; i naređivanje, zaduživanje nekoga da nešto učini; kod Allaha i Njegovo stvaranje.
core.en: An affair or matter, any deed or word; and commanding, charging someone to act; with Allah, also His bringing into being.

أمر.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry أمر: amr is a matter/affair, general for all deeds and words, the verbal noun of charging someone to act, and for Allah also originating (ibdāʿ).

core.bs: Udaljenost, suprotno od blizine, u prostoru ili u značenju; i propast; a kao prijedlog poslije, suprotno od prije.
core.en: Distance, the opposite of nearness, in space or in meaning; also perishing; and, as a particle, after, the opposite of before.

بعد.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entries بعد (two): buʿd is the opposite of nearness, sensory or intellectual, often used of perishing, and baʿd is used as the counterpart of qabl.

core.bs: Pokrivanje nečega onim što ga štiti od prljanja; Allahov oprost čuva Njegovog roba da ga ne dotakne kazna.
core.en: Covering something with what protects it from soiling; Allah's forgiveness shields His servant from being touched by punishment.

غفر.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry غفر: ghafr is clothing a thing with what guards it from dirt, and Allah's maghfira is protecting the servant from being touched by punishment.

core.bs: Dvije stvari jedna uz drugu bez ičega stranog između; otuda bliskost po mjestu, srodstvu, vjeri ili pomoći, i preuzimanje brige.
core.en: Two things following on with nothing foreign between them; hence nearness in place, kinship, faith or support, and taking charge.

ولي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry ولى: walāʾ is two or more things occurring with nothing between them not of them, borrowed for nearness of place, relation, religion, friendship and support; wilāya is support and taking charge of an affair.

core.bs: Dozivanje nekoga, obično imenom – pa otuda i molba, traženje pomoći ili poziv ka nečemu.
core.en: Calling out to someone, usually by name — and so asking, pleading for help, or urging toward something.

دعو.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry دعا: confirmed du‘ā’ as calling (normally with the name), extended to asking/seeking help and to urging toward a thing.

core.bs: Sputavanje radi popravljanja – otuda i presuđivanje, odlučivanje i mudrost.
core.en: Holding something back in order to set it right — hence judging, deciding, and wisdom.

حكم.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry حكم: confirmed the root's asl as restraining for the sake of setting right (the bridle), with judging and hikma treated under it.

core.bs: Čvrsta vlast nad onim čime se raspolaže – posjedovanje stvari i vladanje ljudima naredbom i zabranom.
core.en: Firm control over what one disposes of — owning things, and ruling people by command and prohibition.

ملك.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry ملك: confirmed mulk as firm control of what is disposed of by authority, malik as one who governs people by command and prohibition, and milk (ownership) as the broader genus.

core.bs: Skrivanje nečega od osjetila – otuda noćni pokrov, štit, vrt prekriven drvećem i nevidljivi džini.
core.en: Concealing something from the senses — hence night's cover, a shield, a garden veiled by trees, the unseen jinn.

جنن.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry جن: confirmed the asl as hiding a thing from the senses, with night, shield, tree-covered garden, fetus and jinn derived from it.

core.bs: Blizina – u prostoru, u mišljenju ili u položaju; otuda i tvrdoglavo dičenje onim što se ima.
core.en: Nearness — in place, in one's view, or in standing; from it, being stubbornly proud of what one has.

عند.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry عند: confirmed ‘inda as a word for nearness (place, belief, rank) and ‘anīd/mu‘ānid as one vain or boastful about what he has.

core.bs: Ono za čim svi žude – razum, pravda, korist – suprotno zlu; ponekad i imetak.
core.en: What everyone desires — reason, justice, what benefits — the opposite of evil; at times, wealth.

خير.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry خير: confirmed khayr as what all desire (reason, justice, benefit), opposite of sharr, and its use for wealth.

core.bs: Raširena svjetlost koja omogućava gledanje – očima ili pronicljivošću, kao svjetlo razuma i Kur'ana.
core.en: Spreading light that lets one see — with the eyes, or with insight, as the light of reason and the Quran.

نور.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry نور: confirmed nūr as diffused light that aids seeing, either sensory or perceived by insight (reason, the Qur'an).

core.bs: Sve što raduje i za čim se žudi – po sudu razuma, sklonosti ili osjetila.
core.en: Whatever delights and is desired — as judged by reason, by inclination, or by the senses.

حسن.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry حسن: confirmed husn as everything delightful and desired, in three kinds: by reason, by desire, by sense.

core.bs: Skretanje s pravog puta, namjerno ili iz previda, malo ili mnogo – suprotno uputi.
core.en: Straying from the straight way, on purpose or by oversight, slightly or greatly — the opposite of guidance.

ضلل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry ضل: confirmed dalāl as deviating from the straight path, deliberate or not, little or much, opposite of hidāya.

core.bs: Život u više vidova: rast, osjet, razum, olakšanje od tuge, vječni život – i Allahov život kojem smrt ne pristupa.
core.en: Life on several levels: growth, sensation, reason, relief from grief, life eternal — and the deathless life of Allah.

حيي.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry حيي: confirmed his six uses of hayāt (growth, sensation, intellect, removal of grief, eternal afterlife, Allah's life free of death).

core.bs: Sluh, moć uha da opaža glasove – a u prenesenom smislu i razumijevanje i pokoravanje.
core.en: Hearing, the ear's power to perceive sounds — and by extension understanding, and obeying.

سمع.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry سمع: confirmed sam‘ as the ear's faculty for perceiving sounds, also used for understanding and for obedience.

core.bs: Gradnja, podizanje zdanja – i sin je po tome nazvan, kao onaj koga je otac izgradio.
core.en: Building, raising a structure — a son too is named from it, as one built up by his father.

بني.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry بنى: confirmed binā’ as building and that ibn is so called for being the father's building.

core.bs: Izlazak iz mjesta ili stanja u kojem se bilo – kuće, grada, odjeće ili nekog položaja.
core.en: Emerging from where or how one was — a home, a town, a garment, or a state of affairs.

خرج.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry خرج: confirmed khurūj as coming out of one's place or condition, be it house, town, garment or state.

core.bs: Ispravnost, suprotno kvarenju, najčešće u djelima – i mirenje, otklanjanje odbojnosti među ljudima.
core.en: Soundness, the opposite of corruption, mostly of deeds — and making peace, removing aversion between people.

صلح.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry صلح: confirmed salāh as the opposite of fasād, mainly of actions, and sulh as removing estrangement between people.

core.bs: Put koji se lahko prelazi – i sve što do nečega vodi, bilo dobro ili zlo.
core.en: An easy road — and anything through which something is reached, whether good or bad.

سبل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry سبل: confirmed sabīl as a road with ease in it, used for any means to a thing, good or bad.

core.bs: Ići nečijim tragom – bilo slijedeći ga i pokoravajući mu se, bilo sustižući ga.
core.en: Following in someone's footsteps — whether obeying them, or catching up with them.

تبع.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry تبع: confirmed tabi‘a/ittaba‘a as tracing someone's steps, by compliance, and atba‘a as overtaking.

core.bs: Odvajanje duše od tijela – smrt viđena kao nečije djelo; preneseno i savladati ili pouzdano spoznati.
core.en: Removing the soul from the body — death seen as someone's act; figuratively, to subdue or to know for certain.

قتل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry قتل: confirmed the asl as removing the soul from the body (death viewed as an agent's act), with figurative uses for subduing and for certain knowledge.

core.bs: Uspravljanje i poprimanje oblika – otuda kip, sličnost i prispodoba koja jedno predočava drugim.
core.en: Standing upright, taking visible form — hence an image, a likeness, and a parable showing one thing through another.

مثل.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry مثل: confirmed the asl of muthūl as standing upright/taking form, with timthāl, mithl (likeness) and mathal (parable) under it.

core.bs: Okretanje nečega s jedne strane na drugu – i srce je, kaže se, tako nazvano jer se stalno prevrće.
core.en: Turning something over, from one side to another — the heart, it is said, is named for its constant turning.

قلب.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry قلب: confirmed qalb as turning a thing from one face to another, and (as a reported view) the heart named for its frequent turning.

core.bs: Kad dvojica ili više dijele jednu stvar, opipljivu ili pojmovnu – a u vjeri, pripisivanje Allahu sudruga.
core.en: Two or more sharing in one thing, concrete or abstract — and, in religion, ascribing a partner to Allah.

شرك.notes: ar-Rāġib verified against OpenITI 0502RaghibIsbahani.Mufradat.JK001150-ara1, entry شرك: confirmed shirka as a thing belonging to two or more, concrete or abstract, and the gravest religious shirk as affirming a partner to Allah.
